stemBlocks: The diagram shows the relative positions of two identical light springs, both in equilibrium.
The springs are supporting loads of mass $0.20 \text{ kg}$ and $1.0 \text{ kg}$ as shown.
The same two springs are now connected in parallel, supporting a $2.0 \text{ kg}$ mass as shown.
In this parallel arrangement, what is the total strain energy in the springs? (gravitational field strength = $10 \text{ N kg}^{-1}$; assume that the springs obey Hooke's law)
